QF.id: Cat III AIF Due Diligence and Risk_22

question.text: A Cat III AIF's 'Side Pocket' provision:

answer.text: Allows segregation of illiquid/distressed assets so remaining investors can continue normal redemptions

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Side pocket isolates illiquid/distressed positions so other investors can continue normal operations. **The Trap:** Other interpretations don't match the mechanism. **Cross-Exam Context:** Cross-checked in Topic 7 (Valuation). **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Understand side-pocket mechanics — they can delay redemption materially.
